cards.name: Communal Toast
cards.rulesText: Every living player, including you, reveals and resolves the top card of their Drink Me! pile now.

cards.name: Caught You Cheating
cards.rulesText: When a Cheating card is played while you are still participating, negate that Cheating card and immediately win the gambling round.

cards.name: Sit This One Out
cards.rulesText: When you are required to ante, do not pay that ante and leave the gambling round. Previously anted Gold stays in the pot.

cards.name: Excuse or Escape
cards.rulesText: Choose the applicable branch: when required to ante, avoid that ante and leave the round; or when a Drink would affect you, ignore that entire Drink.

cards.name: Minor Smite

cards.name: Sacred Rebuke
cards.rulesText: Choose another player. They lose 2 Fortitude.

cards.name: The House Takes the Pot
cards.rulesText: During a gambling round, end the round immediately and move the entire pot to the Inn. It cannot be used after the final pass, to dodge an ante caused by starting/raising, or in response to an effect that will itself end the round.

cards.name: Healing Prayer
cards.rulesText: Gain 2 Fortitude.

cards.name: Raise the Stakes
cards.rulesText: Take control of the gambling round and make every active participant ante 1 additional Gold.

cards.name: Join the Game!
cards.rulesText: During your Action phase, start a gambling round; during an existing gambling round, take control.

cards.name: Strong Hand
cards.rulesText: Take control. Until a Cheating card takes control, Gambling cards cannot take control.

cards.name: Blessing and Offering

cards.name: Temple Healing

cards.name: Divine Retribution
cards.rulesText: Immediately after another player causes you to actually lose Fortitude, that original source player loses 2 Fortitude. You cannot use this if the loss was fully ignored/reduced to 0.

cards.name: Steady Yourself
cards.rulesText: Ignore an Action or Sometimes card that directly affects your Fortitude or Alcohol Content.

cards.name: Brace for Impact
cards.rulesText: Ignore an Action or Sometimes card that would directly make you lose Fortitude.

cards.name: Hands Off the Drinks
cards.rulesText: Negate a card that changes a Drink's effects (such as modifying, ignoring, passing, or splitting it). It cannot negate another copy of this mechanic, a card that merely orders Drinks, forces a player to drink, directly changes a player's Alcohol Content, or affects a Drink Event.

cards.name: Hard No
cards.rulesText: Negate a Sometimes card. This counter belongs to a protected counter family: it may itself only be negated by another card in the same family.

cards.name: Extra Round for My Friends

cards.name: You Need This More

Each living player reveals and drinks a Drink from the Inn deck. Compare the revealed Drink's total Alcohol Content for contest scoring even if its effects are ignored, passed or split. Highest score wins 1 Gold from every other player; tied highest players repeat until one winner remains. Drink Events revealed for the contest count as 0 for comparison and resolve according to current event rules.
所有仍在遊戲中的玩家各從飲料牌庫翻開並喝下一杯。比較該次翻開飲料的總酒精值作為比賽分數；即使之後忽略、轉交或平分飲料，原本的比賽分數仍保留。最高者向其他每位玩家各獲得 1 金幣；最高分平手者繼續重複直到產生唯一勝者。比賽中翻到的酒卡事件比較值視為 0，並依現行事件規則處理。
